# Ned offline adaptation

Original authors: openai/plugins authors and contributors

Upstream: https://github.com/openai/plugins/blob/d420d13051bffe4543ed39e30fa46b87148e47dd/plugins/game-studio/skills/react-three-fiber-game/SKILL.md

Commit: d420d13051bffe4543ed39e30fa46b87148e47dd

License: MIT; see LICENSE. Preserve attribution and source links. Modifications by Ned contributors, 2026-11-13. The upstream authors do not endorse Ned.

This is a selective static host adapter, not an installation of the upstream executable plugin, CLI, agents or validators. The method was condensed for Korean/offline use. Online installation, telemetry, cloud services, automatic update, mandatory Q&A, external issue trackers and parallel-agent procedures were omitted. Tools map to Ned host reads/search, approved project edits and available reviewed runtimes. Missing executors and image generation remain explicitly unavailable.

## Ned controlled subagents

Updated by Ned contributors, 2026-11-16. Generic prohibitions now cover external agent installers/runners. Ned’s own spawn_subagent service may delegate bounded research or assigned-file implementation under the parent project and current native permissions. It does not install or execute upstream agents. Child agents cannot delegate, perform builds/Git writes/desktop actions, or answer user decisions. The main agent integrates confirmed results. This changes the host adapter, not the upstream license or provenance.
